design: v002 to R02/R02b. Low wide patch: one main ginseng-like plant and two smaller fruiting plants plus a young one, each a short thick stem, a flat whorl of palmate leaves (five serrated leaflets) and a straight peduncle to a dense globe of glossy crimson berries; soil, moss cushions and pebbles visible between sparse grass. Post: the main plant dug out (pit, clods, torn root), side umbels stripped to broken pedicels, torn leaflets.
material_direction: Dark green leaflets with pinnate veins, yellowing margins and back-light; stem green flushing purple-red at the whorl; berries deep crimson, waxy (rough 0.30) with a dark stylar point, faint inner glow = the kit hot accent.
front_axis: -Y (Blender); GLB exported +Y up, so the front faces +Z in glTF space
not_reproduced_in_game_material: crystal transmission (crystals are opaque with baked colour and emission)
iron metallic (baked as dark iron-grey dielectric: base colour mixed toward 0.055 grey by the metallic amount)
